title: Two-signature payouts and an easier AGM
music: About one minute of original, warm, confident instrumental background music for a short explainer film: West African guitar, soft hand percussion, warm bass and gentle keys, around 96 BPM, steady under a voice, no vocals, a resolved ending.
vo: Most estate disputes aren't about money going missing. They're about nobody being able to show where it went.
With BreeUp, each estate has its own account with our licensed banking partner, and the estate keeps every naira it bills.
Large payouts can need a second approver, often the chairman and the treasurer, so no one person moves estate funds alone.
Every payment is recorded against its home, so the AGM report is a summary of records you already have.
Software keeps the record. Your executives make the calls.
